text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A certain day, {0} had been summoned by Akira. She didn't exactly disclose what she needed out of him, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
その日、{0}は晶に呼び出されていた。
用件の詳細は教えてもらえなかったが──

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Yo, Boy! Doing well? Today, as an apology for all the trouble I've caused you so far, and to thank you for all your hard work, I've planned a little special getaway!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっ、
少年！　
元気してる？
今日はこれまで色々ご迷惑をかけたお詫びと、
少年の労をねぎらって、
特別に
慰安旅行を計画しました！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: So with that said... time for you to have some quality time with this lady right here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってわけで──
お姉さんと
お出かけしようぜ！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait! Don't tell me you've already resolved to return home just like that! You aren't trying to hurt this lady's feelings, are you? I'm gonna cry here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとちょっと！
いきなり帰るこたーないじゃん！
お姉さん傷ついちゃうな～？　
泣いちゃうぞ～？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Well, I know you're not that keen on the idea, you see? I know it sounds a bit fishy if I'm the one saying so, ​​but I really do want to thank you for your efforts, Boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやまあ、
気乗りしないのは
分かるよ？
自分で言うのもなんだけど、
胡散くさいもんね
正直。
だけど
少年の労をねぎらいたいってのはホント。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: I haven't had a chance to see you at all lately, so I've been kind of worried on my end. I mean, you know... I've kind of asked you to take on a lot of unreasonable requests "over there".
text_block_list.orig_text:
最近顔を会わせる機会がなかったから心配してたんだ。
ほら、
あっちじゃ色々無茶なお願いとか聞いてもらってるし。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Ugh, the thorns of his words sting... But as an adult, I can only accept them in silence...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっ、
言葉の棘がチクっと刺さる……
しかし
大人のアタシは黙って受けるのみ……

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: I'm saying it out loud to appeal to your conscience.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミの良心に訴えかけるため、
あえて声に出してます。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Ugh... What? Is that how you're feeling like today, Boy? Your words are starting to sound as sharp as a jackknife, aren't they? Are you trying to aim for the pinnacle of freestyle with that sharp tongue you've got?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぐっ……
なに？　
今日の少年はそういう感じ？
ちょっと言葉の切れ味がジャックナイフ並になってきてるよ？
舌鋒の鋭さでフリースタイルの頂点目指し始めた？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Anyway! Even if you don't agree to spend some quality time with me, atleast value the quality of your health, so let me take a quick medical checkup on you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく！　
お出かけは抜きにしたって、
ちょっとした健康診断くらいはさせてほしいな。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're a very good boy, I'll give you some candy later. Now then, let's close the stall for a bit...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おー
いい子だね、
あとで飴玉をあげよう。
じゃ、
屋台はちょっと閉めて……
と。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Well, it's a simple examination and checkup, so it'll be over soon. First take a seat in this chair right here. Then, next up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
簡単な問診と体調チェックだから
すぐに終わるよ。
それじゃ
こっちの椅子に座って。
えっと、
まずは──

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Yeah. You're perfectly healthy! If I had to comment on something, I'd say you're a little sleep deprived. Try not to get too invested into playing our game.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
至って健康、
問題なし！
強いていえば
寝不足ぎみかな。
ゲームに熱中するのもほどほどにね。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Okay, time to rev up the engine... Oh. Dear customer, how far are we going today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さって、
それじゃエンジンをかけまして……
っと。
お客さん、
今日はどこまで？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: I've told you earlier already. Today is a day to thank you for your hard work, Boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっき言ったでしょ。
今日は少年の労をねぎらう日だって。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Of course, going abroad is a little difficult, but if you want to, I'll take you anywhere you want! With the sole condition it has to be a one-day trip! You have school tomorrow, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがに海外は難しいけど、
希望があれば
大抵のとこには行っちゃうぞ～！
あっでも日帰りできる範囲でね！　
明日学校でしょ？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's decide on a destination. Where should we go? Anywhere is fine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ
目的地を決めようか。
どうする？　
どこでもいいよ！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Here, we've finally arrived... the Tsubakigaoka shopping district! Wait, why?! It's so close! We could get here on foot if we wanted to!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
やってきました椿ヶ丘の商店街！
ってなんで！？　
ド近場じゃん！　
徒歩で行ける距離！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Oh man, my surprise backfired... I had more trouble finding a nearby parking spot than getting here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あちゃー、
サプライズが裏目に出ちゃったかぁ……
移動より
近場の駐車場探す方が
苦労しちゃったよ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Well, as long as you're okay with it, Boy, then I don't mind! So, what should we do? Maybe some shopping? While walking around happily?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
少年がいいならそれで良し！
で、
どこに行く？　
買い物？　
街ブラ？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: We came here by car so fear not when it comes to any kind of luggage! Leave this to me~ Wait, huh? Boy? ...He's not here!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかく車で来たんだ、
大荷物になっても大丈夫！
ここはアタシに任せて──
って、
あれ？　
少年？
……居ないし！！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Geez, where did he go...? Found you! Boy! Don't just leave me behind like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もー
どこ行っちゃって……
見つけたっ！
少年～！　
ちょっと置いていかないでよ～！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Phew, I caught up... Hmm, I smell something fragrant. Is this... a butcher's shop?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぃー、
追いついた……
ん、
なにやら香ばしい匂いが。
ここは……
肉屋？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you're hungry? Did you want to try something different compared to my delicious crepes for a change?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
お腹が空いてたんだ？
たまには
クレープ以外のものも食べたいって感じ？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: In that case, I guess I'll join in too. I don't often get the chance to eat the same thing as you, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なら、
アタシも便乗させてもらおうかな。
キミと同じものを食べる機会もあんまりないしね。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: As for what you've ordered, Boy... a special croquette with lots of beef? Excuse me, one more of these croquettes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
少年のは……
牛肉たっぷり特製コロッケ？
すみません、
追加でこのコロッケもう一つ！

text_block_list.name: Butcher's Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Coming right up! I'll fry it right away, so wait for it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
毎度！　
すぐ揚げちゃうから
待っててね。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Hmm... this croquette is pretty good! The attention to detail in the mixture of ingredients, the crispness of the frying... you can really feel the skilled craftsmanship behind it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むむ……
このコロッケなかなかイケるね！
タネの配合へのこだわり、
カラッとした揚げ具合……
熟練の技術を感じるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: This kind of croquette sure has a lot of special characteristics! Do you come here to eat often, Boy? This place. You say you stop here often on your way home from school? Hmm, I see.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こういうコロッケって
お店ごとの特色が強く出てていいね！
少年はよく行くの？　
あそこのお店。
学校帰りとかによく寄る？　
ふーん、
そうなんだ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Hey, I know it might be rude of me to ask this, but... If you were to choose Boy, between this croquette and my crepe, which of them would win?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ、
こんなこと聞くのも野暮だけどさ。
少年的には、
このコロッケと
うちのクレープ……
どっちに軍配を上げる？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Ack! Is this because I didn't put in enough research...? As a crepe shop owner, this is a serious situation. I'll start developing a new kind of crepe right away that might beat off this competition...
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ、
これはリサーチ不足か……？
クレープ屋の店主としては由々しき事態だぞ。
どんなクレープなら勝てるか、
さっそく商品開発を……

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: No wait, if I'm trying to win here, shouldn't I not limit myself to solely crepes? Shouldn't I try to play on the same ring as my opponent...? Hmm, or...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
勝つだけならクレープに限らなくてもいいのか？
いっそ同じ土俵で勝負するべき……？
うーん
それとも……

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: To win while still maintaining the definition of a crepe... Wait a second, this is a collaboration idea. Croquette x crepe... no, crepe x croquette?
text_block_list.orig_text:
クレープの定義を保ちつつ勝つには……
待てよ、
掛け合わせの発想だ。
コロッケ×クレープ……
いや、
クレープ×コロッケ？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Hah... I see, I see it now! A new crepe! It's a creamy croquette wrapped in crepe batter! Huh? However, wouldn't that no longer be a crepe, but a croquette instead...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ……
見えた、
見えたぞ！　
新作のクレープが！
クレープ生地で包んだ
クリーム系コロッケだ！
あれ、
でもそれって最早クレープじゃなく
コロッケ……？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Hey, I'd like to hear your opinion. What do you think, Boy? AND HE'S GONE AGAIN!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ、
ちょっと意見を聞きたいんだけどさ～？
少年はどう思──
また居なくなってる！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Geez, the moment I take my eyes off you, you run off without a second thought. And this is the second time I've said this piece!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
目を離したらすーぐ居なくなっちゃうんだから。
こんなセリフ言うのも二回目だよ！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: So you... weren't trying to shake me off secretly? To me it seemed like you started walking faster after I waved at you, though?
text_block_list.orig_text:
とか言いながら、
こっそり振り切ろうとしてなかった？
アタシが手振って追いかけた時、
歩くペースを速めたような気がしたけど？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Hmm, you're suddenly blinking a lot more, aren't you? You're also touching your mouth more frequently. Could this be an unconscious defensive reaction? How interesting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
瞬きが急に多くなったね？
それに口元を触る頻度も増えた。
無意識の防御反応かな？　
興味深いね。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess I won't pry any deeper on that. I'll just praise you, Boy... Actually, I'm already with you on your day off for that reason.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ
深くは追及しないでおこうかな。
少年をねぎらう……
っていうか、
もう
キミの休日に
アタシが付いてってる形だしね。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: So, we've arrived at... the arcade! So, which game are you looking for?
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
来たりましたは
ゲームセンター……
っと。
それでお目当てのゲームは
どいつ？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Oh, that one's great! Since you chose this, does that mean you'd like to have a match against me? Sure, I'll play against you as much as you want, Boy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ、
いいねえ！　
これを選んだってことは、
もしかしてアタシとの対戦をご希望かな？
いいよ、
少年が望むならいくらでも相手してあげよう！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's get fighting. Oh, but before that, let me give you this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ早速、
闘ろっか。
っと、その前に
これを渡しておこう。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Right, and it comes with a prepaid charge. I usually prepare one whenever I want to hang around these places from time to time. I don't have my user information registered for various reasons.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
プリペイドチャージ入り。
たまーに遊ぶ時用に用意してるんだ。
ユーザー情報未登録にしてるのは、
まあ
色々な事情で。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: I know that, but see this as a gesture of kindness from this lady right here. If I were to take on you without holding back, you'd end up losing all your allowance, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってる、
でもこれは
お姉さんからの気遣いだ。
アタシが手加減抜きで勝負したら、
少年のお小遣いがすっからかんになっちゃうからさ？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} accepted the IC card that Akira was pushing towards him.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}は晶が押し付けてくるICカードを受け取った。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Now then, I should give this promising youngster a proper chance! Do you want me to have an handicap, Boy? You can even tie just one of my hands up if you want! Now, what kind of character are you going to use?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さーて、
将来有望な若者を
いっちょ揉んでやりますか！
少年、
ハンデほしい？　
片手縛りでも全然いいよ！
さて
一体、
どんなキャラを使うのかな～？

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-looking Character
text_block_list.text: Don't underestimate me!
text_block_list.orig_name: 不良青年っぽいキャラ
text_block_list.orig_text: ナメんじゃねえ！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Huh, he's a brawler, old-fashioned delinquent. Is he the main character of this work? So characters like these still around, huh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ、
喧嘩っ早いオールドタイプの不良キャラか。
この作品の主人公かな？
こういうキャラクターってまだ生き残ってるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Judging from the commands, that character's techniques performance seem straightforward and easy to use. I think... I'll go with this Kung Fu Maid.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コマンドを見る限り、
技性能も素直で使いやすそうだ。
アタシは……
このカンフーメイドでいこうかな？

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-looking Character
text_block_list.text: WHOAAAAAA! I'M ON FIRE!
text_block_list.orig_name: 不良青年っぽいキャラ
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおおおお！　
燃えてきたぜえ！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-looking Character
text_block_list.text: GWAAAAAAAH!!
text_block_list.orig_name: 不良青年っぽいキャラ
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐあああぁぁぁぁぁっ！！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: NO DAMAGE, COM-PLE-TE VIC-TO-RY...! Did I just sound a little too immature there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノーダメージで
完・
全・
勝・
利っ……！
ちょーっと
大人げなかったかな？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: You said that you wanted a serious match without any kind of handicap, so I did my best to fulfill that request.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハンデなしの真剣勝負がいいなんて言うから～
頑張ってリクエストに応えてあげたのに。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Well, if you pride yourself as one of the Seven Crowns, a feat like this should be child's play. Now then, which game shall we play next?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ
七冠を名乗る以上、
これくらいの芸当はできないとね。
さて、
次はどれで勝負する？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so the two of them ended up playing all the games in the arcade...
text_block_list.orig_text: そうして二人は店内のゲームを遊びつくし──

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Yaaaah, that sure was fun! I wonder how long it's been since I've been this passionate?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやー、
遊んだ遊んだ！
こんなに熱中したのいつぶりだろう？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty good at games, aren't I? But now I know why Chris invites you so often to play. Your concentration and reaction speed at the very last minute are pretty impressive.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシも結構やるもんでしょ？
でも、
キミがクリスに誘われた理由が少し分かったよ。
土壇場での集中力と
反応速度は
かなりのものだ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Hey, Boy... do you happen to like videogames? I guess it's a little redundant to ask you that, especially after seeing you play today...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ、
少年はさ……
ゲーム
好き？
って聞かなくても分かるか。
今日の遊びっぷりを見てたらね！

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: I wanted people to play games the way you just did, which is the reason why I was making Astrum in the first place. Or should've, atleast...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなふうに遊んでほしくて、
アタシもゲームを作ってた、
はず
なんだけどなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Well, that's the annoying thing about being an adult. You can't just stop at thinking about the people you're going to play with. There are also human relationships, political groundwork, and all sorts of other things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
大人のめんどくさい所でさ。
遊んでもらう人の事だけ考えていればいい訳じゃないんだ。
人間関係とか
政治的根回しとか、
色々ね。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I believe I've told you this before, Boy. Even though I look like this, I wanted to be a doctor. My Dad is... my father was a doctor.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば、
少年に話した事あったっけ。
こう見えても
医者を目指してたんだ。
父さん……
アタシの父が
医者でね。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: He did everything he could for the sake of others, and saved many patients as a result... It is reductive to say he was a very fine person.
text_block_list.orig_text:
人のために尽くして、
たくさんの患者を救って……
とても立派な人だった。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: That's why I started studying medicine. Because of my new work, I moved from country to country. I followed my father all over the place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシが医学を修めたのもその影響。
仕事の都合で海外を転々としてさ。
父に付いて回って、
色んな所に行ったよ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Refugee camps, remote rural towns, villages in the wilderness... "If there's someone I can help with these hands then...", I remember him saying that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
難民キャンプ、
人里離れた田舎町、
荒野の集落……
「この手で助けられる人がいるなら」
なんて息巻いてさ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: He was busy seeing patients without any time to sleep, and before I knew it, he had become friends with the local people and even taught them how to farm or how to read and write.
text_block_list.orig_text:
寝る間もなく患者を診て回って、
それでいつの間にか、
仲良くなった地域の人と一緒に
農作業や
読み書きを教えたりまでしちゃう始末でね。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: I admired my father's example... But there's no guarantee that everyone will return the goodwill you show them. A lot of things happened... And well, he ended up getting betrayed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな父の背中に憧れた……
だけど、
誰もが善意に善意を返してくれるとは限らない。
色々あって……
まあ、
裏切られるような形になっちゃったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: I've been to many countries around the world, and not only do people only think about themselves, they completely are without care for the other.
text_block_list.orig_text:
地球上の色んな国に行ったけど、
みんな自分のことしか考えてないどころか、
本当は他人のことなんてどうでもいいと思ってる。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: My father saved many people as a doctor and was respected by everyone. ...But despite that, in the end, he was betrayed by those same people he saved and died.
text_block_list.orig_text:
父さんは医師としてたくさんの人を救って、
みんなから尊敬されてた。
……
でも結局は、
人に裏切られて死んだ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: I studied medicine because I admired my father, but I grew to believe that there was no point in saving people...
text_block_list.orig_text:
父さんに憧れて医学は修めたけど、
アタシには
人間を救うことに意味があるとは思えないよ……

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: If you don't know kindness, people will easily betray you. If you don't trust others, you will find malice in their words that doesn't exist. I've been a witness to such a world... so much that I hate it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
優しさを知らなきゃ人は簡単に裏切る。
信用してもらえなければ、
相手の言葉に存在しない悪意を見出す。
そうした世界がある事を……
アタシは嫌というほど見てきた。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: However, if possible, I would like you to remain ignorant to such things, Boy. I hope that the warmth and kindness in your heart will not fade away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど、
叶うなら
少年には知らないままで居てほしい。
キミの心の温かさ、
優しさが、
どうか削れてしまわないように。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: --Without hope, your heart becomes depressed. You feel like you're wandering aimlessly in the dark. And then... you become unable to be kind to people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──希望がないとさ、
心がやさぐれちゃうんだ。
暗闇の中をあてども無く彷徨っている気分になる。
そうすると……
人に優しくできなくなっていく。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: And I'm not trying to single out these places far overseas. Even in this very city... in that hospital in Tsubakigaoka, there are children who spend their days unable to move from their beds.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海外の遠く離れた場所だけじゃない。
この街でも……
あの椿ヶ丘の病院で、
ベッドから動けずに過ごし続ける子たちがいる。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: There's nothing wrong with them, they were just born that way... But they'll never be able to run around in the warm sun, or experience the tickling sensation of getting your feet stuck in the sand on the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何も悪くないのに、
ただそう生まれついただけで……
暖かい陽を浴びて走り回ったり、
砂浜に足を取られる
くすぐったさを知ることもできない。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: However, if it was in a game then... they can do those things inside of a game world. Things they can't do in this world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど、
ゲームでなら……
ゲームの世界でなら
できるんだ。
こっちの世界ではできないことが。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Perception expansion. For someone who will end their life in a country that doesn't exist, is the feeling they get when they swim for the first time in a game fake, and is the smile that comes from there a complete fiction?
text_block_list.orig_text:
認識の拡張──
海の無い国で一生を終えていく人が
ゲームの中で初めて泳いだ時の感覚は偽物で、
そこで生まれた笑顔は
全くの虚構
なのかな？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: It's true that the game world is certainly a virtual world, but... sometimes even truth can be born from fiction, or so I believe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゲームの世界は、
確かに仮想の世界だけど……
そこに真実が生まれる事だってある、
ってアタシは思う。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: If people know hope, happiness, and warmth, they will become kinder. If this exchange of kindness continues, I think the world will become a better place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
希望を、
幸せを、
心の温かさを知れば
人は優しくなれる。
そうした善意の応酬が続いていけば、
より良い世界になっていくんじゃないか
って。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: ...Just kidding. That was all to say that I'm a certain someone who burned with a nasty dream as her fuel. Then I learned the reality of things and became a bit of a jaded old lady, and now... here I am, a nice lady.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なーんて、
青臭い夢に燃えてたのが
昔のアタシ。
そこから現実を知って、
ちょっとスレた
イイ感じのお姉さんになったのが、
今のアタシ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Hey, cut it out! What are you trying to imply there? Don't look at me like that! No matter how you look at me, I've always been a nice lady, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こら、
そこ～！
何言ってんだコイツみたいな目で見ない！
どこからどー見たって、
イイ感じのお姉さんでしょ～？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Well, that's how things are... It's my turn to return the favor to the Boy who always helps me out of the kindness of his heart.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ
そんな訳で……
いつも善意で助けてくれる少年に、
今回はアタシがお返しする番
ってわけ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: So... how was today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで……
今日はどうだったかな？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: At the very least, if it served as a pleasant distraction, it'd be worth the time I took from you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
せめて
キミの気晴らしにでもなったなら、
時間を取ってもらった甲斐もある
ってもんだけど。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Really? I'm glad then. I'm also glad to know what the town you were born and raised in is like.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう？　
ならよかった。
アタシも
キミの生まれ育った街が
どんな所か知れてよかったよ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Yeah, playing together seems to have completely eased the tension. And besides that, I was able to achieve another goal in the meantime.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
一緒に遊ぶことで緊張もすっかり解けたみたいだし。
それに──
もう一つの目標も達成できた。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Throughout the day... Your ability to focus, your ability to judge, your communication skills with others... none of them showed any signs of a problem.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日一日を通じて……
キミの集中力や
判断力、
他者とのコミュニケーション、
どれも問題が発生している兆候は見られなかった。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: So far, I have not seen any symptoms of mental exhaustion. The results of his physical and mental examinations are extremely good, I would say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のところ、
精神的消耗の症状は見られない。
心身ともに
診察結果は極めて良好、
ってところかな。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Anyway! Even if you don't agree to spend some quality time with me, atleast value the quality of your health, so let me take a quick medical checkup on you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく！　
お出かけは抜きにしたって、
ちょっとした健康診断くらいはさせてほしいな。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Yeah. You're perfectly healthy! If I had to comment on something, I'd say you're a little sleep deprived. Try not to get too invested into playing our game.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
至って健康、
問題なし！
強いていえば
寝不足ぎみかな。
ゲームに熱中するのもほどほどにね。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: All that he shows is a sign of sleep deprivation... Atleast I hope it's that. If it was a sleep disorder caused by an autonomic nervous system disorder, that'd be troublesome. I did a quick check to see if he was under a lot of stress, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
単なる寝不足……
ならいいけど。
自律神経が乱れての睡眠障害だったら厄介だな。
強いストレスを受けていないか、
簡単にはチェックしたけど……

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: I knew it, it'd be best to take a little more time to examine him after all. So, the only way to have the Boy show what he's bottled up would be...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり
少し時間をかけて診察した方が良さそうだ。
となると、
少年が自然体を見せてくれそうな言い分は……

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Okay, time to rev up the engine... Oh. Dear customer, how far are we going today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さって、
それじゃエンジンをかけまして……
っと。
お客さん、
今日はどこまで？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: That day, I swore to myself that I would never regret letting you log into Astrum.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの日、
キミをアストルムにログインさせたことを
アタシは絶対に後悔しないって、
そう誓ったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I have a responsibility. A responsibility to protect you, no matter what.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから
アタシには責任がある。
何を差し置いても、
キミを守る責任が。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: ...You may not remember, but it was you who pushed the start button on my cold and rusty body that day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……もう覚えてないかもしれないけど。
冷え切って
錆び付いていたアタシの
スタートボタンを押してくれたのは
キミなんだ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: I said that I wanted to create a better world together, but if those ideals led you to receive an irreparable wound... then I would never be able to stop regretting it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
世界中をより良くしたい、
なんて言って
キミが取り返しのつかない傷を負うような事になったら……
それこそ悔やんでも悔やみ切れない。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: It’s because I saw your kindness, your selfless dedication, your pure light that seeks no self-interest or reward...
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミの善意を、
自らを省みる事のない献身を、
打算も
見返りも求めない、
純粋な光を見たからこそ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: It's because of that, that I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからこそ、
アタシは……

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: This-world... I-really-want-to-save-it~
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱ世界、
救いたいよね～

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, maybe you're right. But don't you think that big wishes are more likely to come true if you say them with a smile rather than a frown?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははは、
そうかもね。
でも大それた願い事ってさ、
しかめっ面より
笑顔で言った方が
叶う気がしない？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Making everyone in the world happy... If that kind of wish starts with a smile, the first one has to be yours.
text_block_list.orig_text:
世界中の人を幸せに……
笑顔にするなら、
まずは最初の一人、
自分自身が笑ってないとさ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Get some rest... Wait, what? Me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
休まないと……
って、
えっ？　
アタシ？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Ah... So you noticed? I was trying to be careful not to give off any pretense.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー……
分かっちゃった？
気取られないよう注意してたつもりなんだけどな……

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: But I never expected that one of my patients would be so concerned about me. They say that doctors often neglect their health, but it's a bit counterproductive if the people you should be taking care of worry about you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
まさかこっちが気遣われるとは。
医者の不養生とはよく言うけれど、
診察した相手に心配されるようじゃ本末転倒だね。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Actually, you see, I was thinking of a way to save the world. I am pretty serious about it. I'm still in the process of realizing it, but it is something on a grand, ridiculous scale, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
実は
世界を救う方法を考えてたんだ。
割と本気で。
まだ実現途中だけど、
壮大で
途方もないスケールの話でさ？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: In order to make that happen, I'm sure I'll need your help. ...I'll be causing you trouble as usual.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それを叶えるためには、
きっとキミの力を借りる事になると思う。
……いつもの事ながら迷惑かけるね。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that's right. You've always... at any time, saved me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
そうだね。
いつも……
いつだって
キミに助けられてきた。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Even when the goal ahead of me was difficult to achieve, you lit the way for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
達成困難な目的が立ちはだかろうとも、
キミが進むべき道筋を照らし出してくれた。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: If a game can change people's hearts, then that will eventually change the world. I wanted to make that fantasy dream come true.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゲームで人の心を変えられれば、
それは巡り巡って世界を変えていく。
そんな絵空事みたいな夢を──
本気で叶えてみたくなった。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: However that game has already begun. There's no turning back... All I can do is try my best to clear it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのゲームはもう始まっている。
後戻りはできない……
アタシにできるのは、
ただ全力で
クリアを目指すだけ。

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Boy, I thought as much already, but... May I ask you again?
text_block_list.orig_text:
少
年、
やっぱりさ。
改めてお願いしてもいいかな？

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: This is a world where crazy things happen all the time, and we're bombarded with helpless difficulties...
text_block_list.orig_text:
とんでもない事態ばかり起きるし、
どうしようもない困難ばかり押し寄せてくる世界だけど……

text_block_list.name: Akira
text_block_list.text: Boy, come with me and we'll save the whole thing, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
少年、
アタシと一緒に、
全部
まるごと
救っちゃおうぜ？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...That's quite the nostalgic dream I just had.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……また、
随分と懐かしい夢を見たもんだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Was it Fio who showed me that dream? ...But there are no traces of her. The usual light also seems to be gone... So... was it just a simple dream?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今の夢を見せたのは
フィオ？　
……にしては痕跡がないな。
いつもの光もなかったようだし……
って事は……
単なるアタシの夢？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Well, that makes sense. By the time the boy woke up "there", I was already being chased by the whole world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
そりゃそうだ。
少年が向こうで目覚めた時には
アタシはもう世界中から追われる身になってたんだから。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: But even though it was merely a dream... That was so embarrassing~! I shouldn't have told the Boy about how I was making the game, or the hardships I've faced...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど、
夢の中とはいえ……
恥ずかしい～！
どんな思いでゲームを作ってるとか、
アタシの苦労話とか少年にするべきじゃなかったなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: He doesn't really have to know about the hardships on the underside of making it. All he has to do is to play it with a purity of heart. I created this world so that everyone can enjoy it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
作る裏側の苦労なんて知らなくていいんだ。
ただ、
純粋に遊んでくれればそれでいい。
みんなに楽しんでもらうために、
この世界を創ったんだから。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Now then... I've given Shizuru-chan and Rino-chan special missions, so I'll go do my job.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ
て……
シズルちゃんとリノちゃんには
特命を出したし、
アタシはアタシの仕事をしに行きますか。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I'll do everything I can with all my might. If there's no turning back, then I have no choice but to go full throttle!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のアタシにできる事を、
全力で。
後戻りできないなら、
フルアクセルで進むしかないよね！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Her cloak fluttering, Labyrista left the hideout that made the guildhouse of "Labyrinth". Her expression was filled with determination and trust in {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
外套を翻し、【ラビリンス】のアジトを後にするラビリスタ。
その表情は、決意と{0}への信頼に
満ちているのだった。
